verdict.rationale: Postmark's developer docs list official libraries for TypeScript, Python, Rails, Ruby, .NET, Java and PHP. Its llms.txt provides an AI-oriented TypeScript path covering install, a shared client, template sends, batch handling with per-recipient MessageID and error reporting, and webhook validation. missing for 10: in-depth documentation for the non-TypeScript SDKs (they appear only as a list), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
